reason: Free YouTube with a 30-minute timer already does the job for me, and I've never paid for a sleep app. Since the trial has no auto-charge I might try it out of curiosity, but I don't see myself paying 4,900 won a month for slightly smarter fading.
objection: I'm glad auto-resume is off by default, but I don't trust a phone sitting next to my bed to really know when I fell asleep just from when I put it down and how much I moved. A few minutes of difference won't feel like it's worth paying for.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fall asleep 10+ minutes faster or stop waking up from the sound cutting off, and it came as a one-time payment of about 10,000 won instead of a subscription.
